!28 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Issue 4540. Compare the two DXC panes: they compile the same shader, differing only in the\0A// `static` keyword on the groupshared declaration.\0A//\0A// Look at the global variable declaration just above `define void @main()`, and at the type on\0A// the stores and the load that use it. !56 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Issue 4540. Compare the two DXC panes: they compile the same shader, differing only in the\0A// `static` keyword on the groupshared declaration.\0A//\0A// Look at the global variable declaration just above `define void @main()`, and at the type on\0A// the stores and the load that use it. In the pane compiled with the keyword, that object has a\0A// 1-bit integer type in the groupshared address space; in the pane without it, the same object\0A// has a 32-bit integer type. docs/DXIL.rst (\22Memory access granularity\22) defines groupshared\0A// memory accesses for 32- and 64-bit types only.\0A//\0A// The i1 form is what shipping DXC has emitted for `static groupshared` since at least\0A// v1.4.1907, and DXIL validation accepts it.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// Compiler Explorer publication source for issue 4540.\0A//\0A// CE gives every pane one shared source, so the one-variable A/B is expressed with a\0A// preprocessor guard: the pane compiled with -DNO_STATIC drops the `static` keyword and is\0A// otherwise identical. Everything else is byte-for-byte the shader from the issue body.\0A//\0A// The transformation itself is controlled locally: manual-case-godbolt-transform.txt shows\0A// this file with and without -DNO_STATIC producing exactly the same two globals as the\0A// untransformed repro.hlsl and control-no-static.hlsl.\0ARWBuffer<uint> TileArgsBufferOut;\0ARWBuffer<uint> TilesOut;\0A\0A#ifdef NO_STATIC\0Agroupshared uint storeTile;\0A#else\0Astatic groupshared uint storeTile;\0A#endif\0A\0A[numthreads(8,8,1)]\0Avoid main(uint3 dtid : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint3 gtid : SV_GroupThreadID, uint3 gid : SV_GroupID)\0A{\0A\09if (gtid.x == 0 && gtid.y == 0)\0A\09{\0A\09\09storeTile = 0;\0A\09}\0A\09\0A\09GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();\0A\0A\09storeTile = 1;\0A\0A\09GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();\0A\0A\09if (gtid.x == 0 && gtid.y == 0 && storeTile > 0)\0A\09{\0A\09\09const uint tileId = gid.y * 1024 + gid.x;\0A\0A\09\09uint tileStoreIdx;\0A\09\09InterlockedAdd(TileArgsBufferOut[0], 1, tileStoreIdx);\0A\09\09TilesOut[tileStoreIdx] = tileId;\09\09\09\0A\09}\0A}\0A"}
